name: Tomigo Daisuke
source:
The protagonist of this work. While attending university, he acquired a massive fortune through foreign exchange trading. Using this capital, he purchased numerous properties and further invested in stocks, becoming a wealthy individual by the age of 25.

Thanks to the enormous passive income from his real estate and stocks, he lives a leisurely, comfortable life alone in his favorite apartment, which he owns.

At first glance, he appears to be a clean-cut, likable young man. However, he possesses an intense, ruthless desire for social status, honor, and especially sex. He has used his overflowing wealth to pursue countless women, but because they came too easily, he quickly grew bored.

Though Daisuke grew tired of womanizing, he developed a twisted desire for women money couldn't buy... specifically, married women. He wanted to possess them.

To fulfill this desire, he prepared an apartment complex specifically for hunting married women. Living in one unit as both owner and manager, he scouted out potential targets.

Then, two irresistibly attractive married women, “Kasumi Terauchi” and “Mimori Yazaki,” moved into the apartment complex one after the other.

Feeling this was a fateful encounter, with two women perfect to his taste appearing right before him, Daisuke followed the desire burning inside him and began to approach the married women.
